title: Complete CS4208 volume and suspend setup for Omarchy #6921
author: doctor
body:
## Purpose

This targets the source branch of [basecamp/omarchy#6921](https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy/pull/6921), so the original author can merge the changes into that PR rather than creating a duplicate Omarchy submission.

## Changes on top of #6921

- add a MacBook9,1/MacBook10,1-specific WirePlumber rule enabling software volume on the CS4208 card while retaining its stereo profile
- install a oneshot system service that safely sets the hardware mixer to 100% at boot and persists it with ALSA state
- select suspend-to-idle only on these two models because the CS4208 speaker amplifier does not recover from deep S3, and install the override on both fresh systems and upgrades
- keep fresh-install system setup separate from per-user WirePlumber setup
- make the migration idempotent, preserve an already-working hand-installed driver, and repair a package whose module is missing for the running kernel
- remove stale WirePlumber route state when activating the targeted rule
- document that suspend-to-idle consumes more battery while suspended than deep S3
- cover fresh-install, upgrade, repair, unsupported-model, and idempotence cases

The package requested by the original PR is provided by [omarchy-pkgs#153](https://github.com/omacom-io/omarchy-pkgs/pull/153), backed by merged [upstream driver PR #60](https://github.com/leifliddy/macbook12-audio-driver/pull/60).

## Validation

- all 12 focused CS4208 shell tests pass
- WirePlumber configuration parses with `spa-json-dump`
- the systemd unit passes `systemd-analyze verify`
- `git diff --check`
- live MacBook10,1 clean-boot validation: the patched codec owns the CS4208, PipeWire exposes the expected two-channel stereo sink, and physical Front Left / Front Right tones are audible
- live suspend validation: the kernel recorded a 20-second `PM: suspend entry (s2idle)` / `PM: suspend exit` cycle, all PipeWire services survived, and physical Front Left / Front Right tones remained audible after resume
- negative control: deep S3 remained physically silent even after the driver's resume callback performed a full codec reinitialization and speaker-route restore, including a delayed retry after platform resume

The aggregate `./test/all` run passes the CS4208 coverage and retains two unrelated environment failures: the absent sibling `omarchy-iso` checkout and the unchanged network-QR test. Neither failing test or implementation area is touched here.

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+[Unit]
+Description=Set the CS4208 speaker hardware mixer for software volume
+After=dev-snd-controlC0.device
+
+[Service]
+Type=oneshot
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/amixer -c0 sset Master 100%% unmute
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/amixer -c0 sset Capture 100%% unmute cap
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/amixer -c0 sset "Internal Mic Boost" 1
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/alsactl store 0
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=dev-snd-controlC0.device

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+# Use software volume for the CS4208 speaker path on 12-inch MacBooks.
+
+product_name="${OMARCHY_MACBOOK12_AUDIO_MODEL:-$(cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name 2>/dev/null)}"
+if [[ $product_name == "MacBook9,1" || $product_name == "MacBook10,1" ]]; then
+  config_home="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}"
+  state_home="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
+
+  install -Dm644 \
+    "$OMARCHY_PATH/default/wireplumber/wireplumber.conf.d/51-macbook-cs4208-softvol.conf" \
+    "$config_home/wireplumber/wireplumber.conf.d/51-macbook-cs4208-softvol.conf"
+  rm -rf "$state_home/wireplumber/default-routes"
+fi

@@ -37,6 +37,10 @@ It is necessary to disable Apple's Secure Boot in order to boot the bootable USB
 
 The installer detects Mac hardware and applies the needed fixes automatically: Broadcom Wi-Fi drivers and firmware, the SPI keyboard driver on the MacBook models that need it, an NVMe suspend fix for those same models, and the CS4208 speaker driver on the 12-inch MacBook (2016 and 2017).
 
+On those 12-inch MacBooks, Omarchy also enables software volume for the internal speakers and keeps the codec's hardware mixer at full scale, since that speaker path has no usable hardware volume control. The capture side is pinned the same way: reinitializing the codec resets every mixer control to muted, and with software volume in charge a muted hardware capture control silently kills the internal microphone.
+
+The CS4208 speaker amplifier does not recover after deep S3 suspend, even when the codec is fully reinitialized. Omarchy therefore uses suspend-to-idle on these two models so audio keeps working after resume. This consumes more battery while suspended than deep S3.
+
 ### Known Limitations
 
 Members of the community are constantly working on solutions to these challenges so if these are problematic for you, join #omarchy-on-other in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/tXFUdasqhY) and see if there's any up-to-date methods for resolving these.
